title.zh: CogVideoX-5B 文生视频官方演示

evidence.quote: This Gradio demo integrates the CogVideoX-5B model, allowing you to perform video inference directly in your browser.

If you are using the following models:

- CogVideoX-2B
- CogVideoX-5B
- CogVideoX-5B-I2V

Please use this release version of the SAT code to run.

compare.runtime: 官方托管 Gradio Space（hf.space 直连），浏览器即用；config 显示 auth_required: false
compare.hardware: Space 卡片 suggested_hardware: l40sx1（L40S ×1）；用户侧仅需浏览器
compare.commercial: 未确认（模型为自定义 CogVideoX LICENSE，Space 卡片未标许可）
compare.reproducibility: 权重 THUDM/CogVideoX-5b 与 SAT 代码公开（release v1.0 点名）；在线 demo 参数未核
compare.maintenance: 官方仓库 release v1.0（published 2024-11-08）；最近提交未核

notes.zh: zai-org（原 THUDM）官方 Space，卡片正文明确说明集成 CogVideoX-5B 做浏览器内视频推理，models 字段指向 THUDM/CogVideoX-5b。发布日取官方 GitHub release v1.0（CogVideoX-1.0，published 2024-11-08，正文点名 CogVideoX-5B）。核验方式：huggingface.co 主站本地不可达，demo 经官方 hf.space 直连验证 200 且无需登录，卡片原文经 hf-mirror.com 镜像读取官方 raw 文件（证据 URL 为官方原址）。Space 卡片未标许可，模型为自定义 CogVideoX LICENSE，不声称开源；本站未实测。
notes.en: Official zai-org (formerly THUDM) Space; the card states it integrates CogVideoX-5B for in-browser video inference, with models pointing to THUDM/CogVideoX-5b. Release date taken from official GitHub release v1.0 (CogVideoX-1.0, published 2024-11-08, body names CogVideoX-5B). Verification: huggingface.co unreachable locally; demo returned 200 via the official hf.space domain with auth_required false; card read from the official raw file via hf-mirror.com (evidence URLs remain official). The Space card carries no license and the model uses a custom CogVideoX LICENSE; no open-source claim. Not run by this site.
